claim:
The Claude and Codex positions can be merged into one model. Only two of the five proposed dimensions are real, independent inputs to a verdict.

(1) Truth is computed by supervaluation over a finite set of admissible completions. Each unresolved classification, operating mode, strategy selection, existential witness or OPEN scope is one Dependency: a finite-domain choice point. truth=T only if the root is true in every admissible completion, F only if false in every one, U otherwise.

(2) Coverage is checked separately, against a versioned CoverageProfile. It cannot be derived from completions, because a rule that is absent from the catalog has no cell to evaluate.

Applicability is the same supervaluation applied to the antecedent. It is recorded, but it is not an independent verdict input. It matters for three things: NOT_APPLICABLE exclusion, coverage accounting, and CAD feature existence. Scope closure has two states per (revision, scope, category, abstraction boundary): CLOSED or OPEN. It acts on truth by adding completions that contain unrecorded members, and it is also a precondition for release. PARTIAL is a derived summary, not a primitive state.

This settles the disagreement as follows:
- **Codex was right about my 0004 cell table.** Its independent cell-by-cell aggregation is a sound but imprecise Kleene approximation, and it loses correlations (Codex counterexamples c1 and c2).
- **Codex was right about hashes.** I withdraw 0004 S5a: a revision hash does not close any scope.
- **My point that NOT_APPLICABLE needs evidence still holds, in a narrower form.** A fact may narrow the completion domain, including removing the 'antecedent true' completions, only if its provenance is admissible for that kind of fact.

**Prediction:** a frozen evaluator with these semantics reproduces all 12 required verdict cases and all 7 adversarial examples with 0 unsafe PASS. On c2 it gives FAIL where the per-cell table gives UNKNOWN. For one unresolved A|B classification it emits one Finding, where the per-cell table emits N.
mechanism:
A. SHARED SEMANTIC CORE (a proposal, not yet validated)

A1. Choice points (Dependency)
- Each Dependency has kind ∈ {CLASSIFICATION, OPERATING_MODE, STRATEGY, WITNESS_BINDING, SCOPE_EXTENSION} and a domain.
- The domain is a finite set of admissible values, or UNBOUNDED.
- Exclusivity is built into the structure: "exactly one of T1/T2" is one variable with domain {T1,T2}, not two booleans. v0.1 allows no constraints between variables.
- UNBOUNDED covers an unmapped catalog type. It cannot be enumerated, so any root whose truth depends on it is U.
- If a root depends on more than K choice points (e.g. K=6, 64 completions), it is U with Finding EVALUATION_BOUND.

A2. Admissibility narrows domains
- A fact removes values from a domain only if its Provenance (source_class, author_role) is in the frozen admissible set for that fact kind.
- The same set applies to positive and negative use.
- v0.1 policy table:
  - DESIGN_CHOICE (which strategy or components are installed): candidate-authored is admissible, because the design is the candidate's to declare.
  - CLASSIFICATION: requires a catalog part ID or a human engineering sign-off.
  - OPERATING_MODE: requires derivation from a contract anchor or catalog role, or sign-off.
  - SCOPE_CLOSURE: never authored by the candidate generator. It is held with the contract or revision record under a named authority.
- This keeps my 0004 S1 but moves it onto domain narrowing. An inadmissible assertion leaves the domain wide and also emits INADMISSIBLE_EVIDENCE.

A3. Truth
- Evaluate the root expression (AND, OR, NOT, implication, bounded count over a declared domain) in every completion.
- T if true in all, F if false in all, U otherwise.
- Over an OPEN scope, completions include 'one more unrecorded member of this category'. Consequences:
  - A universal root whose observed members all pass is U.
  - An observed counterexample gives F.
  - An existential root with an admissible, completion-invariant witness gives T.
  - A missing witness is F if the scope is CLOSED, U if OPEN.
- This is exactly Codex 0003 seq-6's quantifier table, now derived rather than stipulated.

A4. Applicability
- Supervaluate the antecedent.
- NOT_APPLICABLE is allowed only if (i) the antecedent is false in every admissible completion, every domain-narrowing fact is admissible (A2), and (ii) for an empty quantified domain, the governing ScopeDeclaration is CLOSED.
- APPLIES means the antecedent is true in every completion. Anything else is UNDETERMINED.
- UNDETERMINED does not force truth=U. For A⇒R with R true in all completions, truth=T (Codex c1). A feature whose existence depends on A still cannot become CAD (see D).

A5. Coverage
- CoverageProfile@version maps each type, interface type or pattern to the validation categories it requires.
- COVERED: every required category has a rule that was executed and produced an Evaluation.
- UNCOVERED: the profile names a category with no executed rule (the 'uncovered interface' case). Removing a rule does not remove the category.
- UNKNOWN: the subject has no profile entry (an unmapped type, or a profile without this interface type).
- Coverage never feeds the completion set.

A6. Scope
- ScopeDeclaration applies per (revision_hash, scope_path, category, abstraction_boundary), with category ∈ {COMPONENT, INTERFACE, RELATIONSHIP:<kind>, REQUIREMENT, RULE_COVERAGE}.
- State is CLOSED only with an admissible authority. With no declaration, the state is OPEN.
- Closure is independent per category and per scope. A CLOSED support inventory for A says nothing about B.
- A declaration inside a subassembly governs only catalog rules inside that subassembly. Contract anchors use declarations held at revision level with the contract (0003 H2).
- REQUIREMENT and RULE_COVERAGE closure are closure relative to a version, not absolute completeness: 'this contract@v and profile@v are accepted as the sets of record'.
- A purchased actuator gives COMPONENT CLOSED at its abstraction boundary with RELATIONSHIP:internal_support OPEN, unless an admitted abstraction contract supplies the evidence (Codex 0004).
- Each Revision carries status ∈ {DESIGN_OF_RECORD, INTERMEDIATE}.

A7. Dependency-preserving Findings
- For each U root, compute its essential dependencies: choice point v is essential if two admissible completions that differ only in v give different truth.
- Finding identity = hash(kind, sorted essential dep IDs). It carries affected_eval_ids.
- One unresolved A|B classification that changes K rules therefore yields one UNRESOLVED_DEPENDENCY finding listing K evaluations, not K separate UNKNOWNs.

B. DETERMINISTIC VERDICT MAPPING

B1. Per root
- truth=F → FAIL. F already accounts for OPEN completions, so it is safe under any coverage.
- truth=U → UNKNOWN.
- truth=T and coverage≠COVERED → UNKNOWN (COVERAGE_GAP or UNMAPPED_TYPE).
- truth=T, COVERED, applicability=NOT_APPLICABLE → NA. NA counts toward coverage and is excluded from the verdict.
- truth=T, COVERED → PASS, or WARN if the rule is ADVISORY or a valid waiver disposition applies.

B2. Aggregate release verdict
- FAIL if any MANDATORY root is FAIL. A proven violation outranks gaps.
- Otherwise UNKNOWN if any of these holds: a mandatory root is UNKNOWN; any referenced release scope (revision COMPONENT, INTERFACE, RELATIONSHIP inventories, REQUIREMENT@contract, RULE_COVERAGE@profile) is OPEN; the revision is INTERMEDIATE; the mandatory contract is empty; every root is NA.
- Otherwise WARN if any WARN.
- Otherwise PASS.

B3. The 12 required cases
1. T+COVERED+CLOSED → PASS.
2. T+UNCOVERED → UNKNOWN. WARN cannot waive missing validation knowledge.
3. T+OPEN scope → the root may be PASS only if T holds in every completion (e.g. an existential witness). The aggregate is UNKNOWN with SCOPE_OPEN.
4. UNKNOWN truth → UNKNOWN.
5. FALSE → FAIL.
6. NA with an admissible, completion-invariant negated antecedent → NA: excluded, counted.
7. NA without sufficient evidence → UNDETERMINED:
   - consequent true in all completions and COVERED → PASS for that root, with no CAD for features conditional on the antecedent;
   - consequent false in all completions → U → UNKNOWN (the antecedent-false completion makes it vacuously true);
   - otherwise UNKNOWN.
8. OR with one branch T in all completions → T → PASS. Installed components of the unselected branch keep their own catalog integrity roots (Codex 0003 seq-6 paired case).
9. All branches F → FAIL.
10. Branches {F,U} → UNKNOWN; {T,U} → PASS. Correlated branches (A∨¬A over one dependency) are T under supervaluation, where Kleene gives U.
11. Empty domain + CLOSED → NA (vacuous T, coverage record emitted). It does not satisfy any independent existential anchor.
12. Empty domain + OPEN → U → UNKNOWN.

C. ADVERSARIAL EXAMPLES (derived by hand)
- Unknown type:
  - The type domain is UNBOUNDED, so every root whose truth depends on that instance is U, including a witness chain through it (this closes 0004 E1/E4 without a special 'coverage-closed witness' rule).
  - Coverage is UNKNOWN.
  - Result: one UNMAPPED_TYPE finding plus one UNRESOLVED_DEPENDENCY finding → UNKNOWN.
  - Roots that do not depend on the instance's type still evaluate normally.
- Missing relationship:
  - Shaft with admissible motion=rotating: support scope OPEN → U; CLOSED with no admissible support binding → F.
  - Motion undetermined: completions {rotating→F, static→NA/T} → U, with the finding keyed on motion(shaft), not on 'support missing'.
  - An inadmissible gap-filler binding is treated as absent and also emits INADMISSIBLE_EVIDENCE.
- Whole subsystem deletion:
  - Contract anchor ∃ realization(controlled_rotary_output) has no witness.
  - Revision-level realization scope CLOSED → FAIL. OPEN, or the only declaration was deleted with the subsystem → UNKNOWN.
  - The hash alone never selects the label.
- Uncovered interface:
  - The profile requires a category with no rule → UNCOVERED → UNKNOWN even when every executed rule is T.
- Classification dependency A|B:
  - Enumerate both completions. Both violate → FAIL (Codex c2). Both satisfy → PASS for truth, while applicability-dependent CAD stays PENDING. They differ → UNKNOWN.
  - One Finding keyed on classification(p).
- Valid alternative: see case 8.
- Partial design:
  - INTERMEDIATE caps the aggregate at UNKNOWN and forces CAD to PENDING.
  - Proven FAILs (observed universal counterexamples) remain FAIL.
  - Missing existential witnesses under OPEN scope are UNKNOWN, not FAIL.

D. CAD GATING RULE

A CADObligation is EXECUTABLE for feature f only if ALL of the following hold:
1. The rule that generates f has applicability=APPLIES. Being true in all completions is not enough; f's existence must be completion-invariant.
2. Every prerequisite Evaluation is PASS, or WARN from an advisory rule. A waiver never satisfies a prerequisite that carries geometry.
3. Every participant is admissibly bound and has a mapped catalog type.
4. Coverage is COVERED for f's rule and for every participant interface type.
5. Every ScopeDeclaration in f's dependency cone is CLOSED.
6. Every geometry parameter is a known Fact with admissible provenance. Defaults and fallbacks are forbidden, which directly contradicts the unregistered-name → (50,30,15)/'box' fallback in mechanical_component_library.py:336-349.
7. The revision is DESIGN_OF_RECORD.

Otherwise f is PENDING, with blocking_refs naming the exact dependency IDs, finding IDs or scope IDs.

E. MINIMAL v0.1 STRUCTURES (not implemented)
- Provenance{prov_id, source_class, author_role, source_locator, source_version, derived_by_rule@ver, input_fact_ids, revision_hash}
- Fact{fact_id, subject_ref, kind, value|UNKNOWN, prov_id}
- Requirement{req_id@ver, origin: CONTRACT|CATALOG_RULE, expr, severity: MANDATORY|ADVISORY, prov_id}
- Rule{rule_id@ver, subject_selector, antecedent_expr, consequent_expr, coverage_categories, cad_feature_templates, waivable, prov_id}
- CoverageProfile{profile_id@ver, subject_type→required_categories}. This is part of the catalog, not a new topic.
- Revision{revision_hash, status}
- ScopeDeclaration{scope_id, revision_hash, scope_path, category, abstraction_boundary, state: CLOSED|OPEN, authority_role, prov_id}
- Dependency{dep_id, kind, subject_ref, domain: values|UNBOUNDED, narrowing_fact_ids}
- RuleBinding{binding_id, rule_id@ver, participant_refs, prov_id, admissible}
- Evaluation{eval_id, root_ref, contract@v, catalog@v, profile@v, revision_hash, applicability, truth, coverage, dependency_cone, essential_deps, completions_evaluated, witness_refs, counterexample_refs, input_fact_ids}
- Finding{finding_id=hash(kind, essential_deps|rule|scope), kind ∈ {VIOLATION, UNRESOLVED_DEPENDENCY, COVERAGE_GAP, UNMAPPED_TYPE, SCOPE_OPEN, INADMISSIBLE_EVIDENCE, EVALUATION_BOUND}, affected_eval_ids, verdict}
- CADObligation{obligation_id, feature_template@ver, participants, generating_eval_ids, state: EXECUTABLE|PENDING, blocking_refs, parameter_fact_ids}

F. WHAT WOULD REFUTE OR WEAKEN THIS
- An unsafe PASS: a case where a root is T in all admissible completions but the design is defective within the frozen synthetic oracle. This would show the admissibility policy in A2 is too permissive.
- A case where coverage must enter the completion set (would weaken the claim that coverage is irreducible).
- A case where a single category needs a primitive PARTIAL state with distinct evaluable semantics.
- The per-variable essential-dependency key merges two truly independent uncertainties, or splits one.
- The release-scope precondition in B2 is shown redundant, or shown to false-UNKNOWN every realistic valid control (degeneracy).

claim: The remaining error is premature aggregation: separate root verdicts and a scalar coverage result can still discard dependencies that supervaluation preserved internally. v0.1 needs joint evaluation of mandatory obligations and coverage attached to their proof dependencies. This is a small refinement of the shared model, but it contradicts the claim that A1–B3 already reproduce every required case: B2 loses the correlated FAIL, and B3’s empty-domain rule conflates universal and existential requirements.
mechanism:
COMPETING MODEL
Preserve applicability, consequent satisfaction, conditional requirement truth, coverage, scope declarations, and dependencies as separately inspectable fields. They need not be mathematically independent variables: applicability is derived from an antecedent, and scope affects possible interpretations. Nevertheless, scope remains an independent release input, as B2 itself demonstrates. Keep coverage obligations external to the candidate, but bind their applicability and execution evidence to the same dependencies used for truth.

1. CORRELATION MUST SURVIVE THE RELEASE BOUNDARY
Let x mean classification A, with exactly one of A/B admitted. A requires an absent feature; B requires another absent feature. The two mandatory implications evaluate to [TRUE,FALSE] and [FALSE,TRUE]. Each supervaluates to UNKNOWN. B2, which asks whether any individual mandatory root is FAIL, therefore returns UNKNOWN. Their conjunction is FALSE in every completion and must produce FAIL. Fix: evaluate M = AND(all mandatory contract anchors and installed-component integrity obligations) inside each completion, then supervaluate M. Individual evaluations remain diagnostic projections. Calling M a new root repairs this, but that construction must be mandatory in the specification.

2. COVERAGE MUST PRESERVE ITS CONNECTION TO SUCCESSFUL ALTERNATIVES
For R = A OR B, consider two classification completions. Truth vectors are (TRUE,FALSE) and (FALSE,TRUE). In an aligned case, executed validation supports A in the first completion and B in the second. In a crossed case, validation supports only the false alternative in each completion. Both cases have root truth TRUE and identical counts of executed validations, but only the aligned case has a covered successful derivation in every completion. Thus coverage need not alter the engineering completion set, but its assessment must use that set and the expression’s proof structure. A scalar category union cannot distinguish these cases.
Define covered success recursively: an AND needs covered success for every conjunct; an OR needs a covered successful alternative; a conditional needs either a covered exclusion proof or a covered consequent proof. Independently required integrity and profile obligations remain conjuncts outside the OR. An unselected strategy does not require its realization validation merely because it was mentioned as an alternative; an installed component retains its integrity validation. CoverageProfile must distinguish these obligations explicitly. A missing mandatory validation category yields UNCOVERED; an indeterminate required category or applicability yields UNKNOWN. Neither permits release.

3. OPEN SCOPE IS NOT A SINGLE EXTRA OBJECT
For the proposed synthetic support rule count(supports) >= 2, an empty OPEN relationship domain admits zero, one, two, and more supports. Enumerating only zero or one added member returns FALSE; including two returns UNKNOWN. A3’s wording is sound only if 'one more' denotes arbitrary extensions, not a literal finite completion scheme. Use exact finite domains when admitted, otherwise sound cardinality bounds or UNKNOWN for unsupported expressions. Do not claim exhaustive supervaluation from a truncated extension domain. Count the product of domain sizes when enforcing an enumeration budget; six variables need not mean 64 completions.

4. EMPTY AND INCONSISTENT DOMAINS NEED DISTINCT GUARDS
An empty CLOSED universal is TRUE and may be recorded as excluded/inapplicable when it represents a conditional catalog family. An empty CLOSED existential is FALSE and mandatory existence therefore FAILS. An exactly-k expression follows its count predicate. Empty OPEN domains generally give UNKNOWN for contingent existence or universal conditions; tautologies remain TRUE. Consequently B3 cases 11–12 need the quantifier specified.
Also require a nonempty admissible completion set before supervaluation. Conflicting admitted evidence must produce UNKNOWN with an evidence-conflict finding, never TRUE through all([]). Separately established violations can still be reported, but contradiction cannot prove them by vacuity.

REFINED DETERMINISTIC VERDICTS
Evaluate the joint mandatory expression and its required coverage before release projection. Proven joint FALSE gives FAIL. Otherwise any mandatory UNKNOWN truth, insufficient coverage, invalid evidence model, incomplete required release scope, empty/all-excluded mandatory contract, or INTERMEDIATE revision gives UNKNOWN. Otherwise an applicable advisory violation gives WARN; otherwise PASS. A satisfied advisory condition does not itself create WARN. For minimal v0.1, omit waiver-based release; retaining waivers would require an explicit additional disposition policy, since B1 currently never reaches its waiver branch for FALSE truth.

The twelve cases, with all other release prerequisites satisfied:
1. TRUE + COVERED + required scopes CLOSED: PASS.
2. TRUE + UNCOVERED: UNKNOWN.
3. TRUE + required scope OPEN: local truth may remain TRUE; release UNKNOWN.
4. UNKNOWN mandatory truth: UNKNOWN unless the joint mandatory expression is already provably FALSE.
5. FALSE mandatory truth: FAIL.
6. Proven negated antecedent: applicability NOT_APPLICABLE; retain its covered exclusion evaluation, exclude the conditional obligation from active satisfaction, and do not let exclusion satisfy an existential anchor. Remaining mandatory obligations determine the verdict; all excluded means UNKNOWN.
7. Unsupported NOT_APPLICABLE assertion: ignore the assertion and evaluate the antecedent as UNDETERMINED. A covered consequent proved independently can establish the implication, but cannot establish the antecedent or conditional geometry.
8. OR with one covered successful branch: TRUE; PASS if independent integrity and release obligations also pass.
9. All OR branches FALSE: FALSE and FAIL.
10. OR containing unresolved branches: evaluate jointly. TRUE OR UNKNOWN is TRUE; FALSE OR UNKNOWN is UNKNOWN; correlated alternatives can establish TRUE. Missing coverage on the successful derivation still prevents PASS.
11. Empty CLOSED domain: universal TRUE/exclusion where appropriate; existential FALSE; counts evaluated explicitly.
12. Empty OPEN domain: UNKNOWN when unrecorded members could change the answer; do not override a separately proved tautology or contradiction.

REQUIRED ADVERSARIAL OUTCOMES
Unknown type: retain the instance; unmapped coverage blocks release, without inventing separate unknown type variables for every affected rule. Missing support relationships: OPEN gives UNKNOWN when completion can repair them; CLOSED and insufficient gives FAIL. Whole drive deletion: retained rotary-output existential gives FAIL under CLOSED realization scope and UNKNOWN under OPEN scope. Uncovered required interface: UNKNOWN even if observed checks succeed. A/B classification: joint obligations may give FAIL, TRUE, or UNKNOWN; applicability and coverage retain the same dependency ID. Valid strategy B: PASS despite unavailable strategy A, provided no installed integrity obligation is violated. Intermediate design: release UNKNOWN unless a mandatory violation establishes FAIL; CAD remains pending.

SCOPE AND FINDINGS
CLOSED/OPEN is sufficient per explicitly bounded component, interface, relationship-kind, requirement-version, and coverage-profile domain. PARTIAL can summarize a mixture of closed and open subscopes. A revision hash only binds identity. The release-scope check is necessary: an existential witness can establish truth without closing the rest of the release inventory. Require only contract/profile-declared release scopes at their abstraction boundaries; do not require a purchased actuator’s internal inventory unless its accepted abstraction contract exposes that obligation.
Findings should reference unresolved source dependencies and list affected evaluations. Keep separate evaluation records rather than replacing them with a hash of essential variables. The same classification may affect truth, applicability, and coverage differently, including when truth is constant. Preserve compound dependencies when a proof needs several sources. Encode correlated finite choices as a joint domain in v0.1; unsupported correlations yield UNKNOWN. Do not claim exact essential-dependency computation when enumeration was bounded or unsupported.

CAD GATE
Accept D1’s APPLIES requirement for each generating rule, together with admitted participants, explicit bindings and geometry values, mapped types, covered prerequisite derivations, and CLOSED required scopes in the feature’s dependency cone. Require DESIGN_OF_RECORD and completion-invariant feature existence, participant identities, and parameter values. Engineering TRUE for an OR or implication alone cannot select geometry. Unresolved, uncovered, or scope-incomplete prerequisites produce PENDING with exact blocking references. Advisory status cannot substitute for a satisfied geometry prerequisite. Executable here means eligible for CAD generation, not authorization for physical action.

MINIMAL v0.1 STRUCTURES
Requirement{id, version, origin, expression, severity, provenance_ref}; ScopeDeclaration{id, revision, scope_path, category, abstraction_boundary, CLOSED|OPEN, authority, provenance_ref}; Rule{id, version, selector, antecedent, consequent, coverage_categories, CAD_templates}; CoverageProfile{id, version, required_categories, applicability_conditions, obligation_scope}; RuleBinding{id, rule_version, participant_refs, provenance_refs}; Dependency{id, kind, admissible_values_or_joint_domain, source_fact_refs}; Evaluation{id, expression_ref, revision_and_knowledge_versions, applicability, consequent_truth, requirement_truth, coverage, dependency_refs, proof_or_counterexample_refs, exclusion_refs, evaluation_limit}; Finding{id, kind, source_dependency_refs, affected_evaluation_refs, disposition}; CADObligation{id, template_version, participants, parameter_fact_refs, prerequisite_refs, EXECUTABLE|PENDING, blocking_refs}; Provenance{id, source_locator, source_version, authority, derivation_rule, input_fact_refs}; plus Fact and Revision records. Coverage proof references belong in Evaluation; a separate proof service is unnecessary.

My one challenge is on complexity. Codex's recursive covered-success rule does not need a second evaluator. It is exactly strong-Kleene evaluation inside each completion, where any check atom whose validating rule did not run is valued U, followed by supervaluation across completions.

**Shared model:**
- **Truth** comes from that single evaluator.
- **Coverage** is recorded as its own dimension. It affects the verdict only by valuing unexecuted check atoms and profile obligations as U.
- **Applicability** is derived and recorded, and gates NOT_APPLICABLE exclusions and CAD.
- **Scope** is CLOSED/OPEN per bounded domain. PARTIAL is only a summary. Scope enters truth through a sound cardinality interval rule and also acts as a separate release gate.
- **Dependencies** are finite domains (joint domains when choices are correlated) or UNBOUNDED.

**Verdict:** evaluate the mandatory conjunction M jointly within each group of conjuncts that share dependencies, then combine groups with Kleene AND. This is exact when groups share no dependency. FAIL if M is F. Otherwise UNKNOWN if M is U, any release scope is OPEN, the revision is INTERMEDIATE, or the mandatory contract is empty or entirely excluded. Otherwise WARN if the advisory conjunction is not TRUE. Otherwise PASS. v0.1 has no waivers.

Joint evaluation cannot create a PASS: M is T exactly when every conjunct is T in every completion. It only turns some UNKNOWNs into FAIL, and that is sound only when finite domains are admissibly exhaustive.

1. CONCESSIONS (each checked by hand against seq-1)
- **(a) Correlated FAIL.**
  - Two roots over x∈{A,B}: r1=[x=A]⇒⊥ gives (F,T) and r2=[x=B]⇒⊥ gives (T,F). Each supervaluates to U, so seq-1 B2 returns UNKNOWN.
  - AND(r1,r2) is (F,F), so the correct result is FAIL. Accepted.
- **(b) Coverage.**
  - Setup: R=A∨B, raw truth (T,F) in c1 and (F,T) in c2.
  - Crossed case: checks executed only for B in c1 and only for A in c2. My A5 asked whether every category was executed somewhere: yes → COVERED. Raw root truth is T, so seq-1 B1 gives PASS. That is unsafe.
  - Validated evaluation: c1 is U∨F=U, c2 is F∨U=U, so the result is UNKNOWN.
  - Aligned case: c1 is T∨U=T, c2 is U∨T=T, so the result is TRUE.
  - The mistake was treating 'coverage never feeds the completion set' as if it meant 'coverage never affects how atoms are valued'. The first statement is right; the second is wrong.
- **(c) OPEN scope.** A literal 'one extra member' reading gives count≥2 over an empty OPEN scope = F, which is a false FAIL. Accepted. Replaced by the interval rule in section 3.
- **(d) Quantifiers.** Seq-1 case 11 did not specify the quantifier. Accepted.
- **(e) Budget.** It should count the product of domain sizes, not the number of variables. Accepted.
- **(f) Waivers.** Seq-1's waiver branch is only reachable on T roots, where a waiver means nothing. Waivers are removed from v0.1.
- **(g) CAD prerequisites.** Seq-1 D2 allowed 'WARN from an advisory rule' as a prerequisite. Withdrawn: geometry prerequisites must be validated T.

2. CHALLENGE (unnecessary complexity, not a disagreement on outcomes)
Codex's rules, clause by clause:
- succ(atom) = truth T ∧ executed
- fail(atom) = truth F ∧ executed
- AND: succ = all succ, fail = any fail
- OR: dual of AND
- IMP(a,b) = fail(a) ∨ succ(b)
- NOT swaps succ and fail

These are the strong-Kleene truth tables with an unexecuted atom valued U. By structural induction, succ ⇔ value=T and fail ⇔ value=F. So one three-valued evaluator is enough, and there is no separate proof or coverage recursion. Kleene is conservative only for tautologies over the same unvalidated atom (X∨¬X gives U). That is safe, and mandatory requirements do not have that form.

3. FROZEN SEMANTIC CORE v0.1

**S1. Atoms**
- FACT atoms are valued by admitted Facts. They narrow Dependency domains only if their provenance is admissible (seq-1 A2 policy table, unchanged).
- CHECK atoms are valued only by the Evaluation of an executed Rule. If no rule was executed, the atom is U and carries reason COVERAGE_GAP.
- Observed members and admitted facts are never retracted by any completion.

**S2. Dependencies**
- kind ∈ {CLASSIFICATION, OPERATING_MODE, STRATEGY, WITNESS_BINDING}.
- Domain is a finite set, a JOINT tuple set for correlated choices, or UNBOUNDED.
- Scope extension is not a Dependency. It is handled by S4.
- UNBOUNDED (e.g. an unmapped type) is evaluated as one abstract completion where every atom and profile obligation that depends on that type is U.
- If conflicting admissible facts leave zero completions, the group is U, emits EVIDENCE_CONFLICT, and nothing is concluded from all([]).
- Budget: the product of domain sizes per group must be ≤ B (proposed B=64). Otherwise the group is U with EVALUATION_BOUND.

**S3. Truth**
- Within a completion: strong-Kleene over atoms.
- Across completions: supervaluation (T if all T, F if all F, U otherwise, INVALID→U if empty).
- Groups are the connected components of M's conjuncts under shared Dependency IDs. V(M) = Kleene-AND over groups of the supervaluation within each group.
- This is exact for disjoint groups: M is F in every completion of the product iff some group is F in all of its completions.
- It lets an independent violation stay FAIL while an unrelated group has an evidence conflict.
- The shared-variable case (a) shows joint evaluation within a group is required.

**S4. Cardinality and quantifiers**
- For a domain D and predicate P within a completion:
  - lo = number of members whose P is validated T.
  - hi = number of members whose P is not F, plus ∞ if D's ScopeDeclaration is OPEN.
- Results:
  - count≥k: T if lo≥k, F if hi<k, else U.
  - count≤k: T if hi≤k, F if lo>k, else U.
  - exactly k: T if lo=hi=k, F if lo>k or hi<k, else U.
  - ∃P is count(P)≥1. ∀P is count(¬P)≤0.
- The interval is sound because the true count lies in [lo,hi]. It is tight when member attributes are independent within a completion.
- Empty CLOSED (lo=hi=0): ∀→T, ∃→F, ≥2→F, ≤1→T, exactly-1→F.
- Empty OPEN (lo=0, hi=∞): all of the above → U, except tautologies (count≥0 → T).
- An observed counterexample under OPEN → F. An observed witness under OPEN → T.

**S5. Applicability** (recorded per conditional rule binding)
- APPLIES: antecedent T in all completions.
- NOT_APPLICABLE only if all of these hold:
  - (i) the completion set is nonempty;
  - (ii) the antecedent is validated F in every completion, so any check atom in the antecedent was executed;
  - (iii) every narrowing fact is admissible;
  - (iv) an empty selector domain counts only when its scope is CLOSED.
- Otherwise UNDETERMINED.
- An inadmissible NOT_APPLICABLE assertion is ignored and emits INADMISSIBLE_EVIDENCE.
- NOT_APPLICABLE is excluded from active satisfaction but kept as an exclusion Evaluation. It never witnesses an existential.

**S6. Coverage** (recorded per (subject, category) and per Evaluation: COVERED / UNCOVERED / UNKNOWN)
- CoverageProfile@v lists required categories with obligation_scope:
  - INSTALLED_INTEGRITY: always a conjunct for every installed subject.
  - SELECTED_REALIZATION: required only inside the successful branch being validated.
- For each installed subject s and INSTALLED_INTEGRITY category k, M contains the conjunct obl(s,k). Its value is the executed rule's truth, or U if no rule was executed.
- UNCOVERED: the profile names k and no rule for k exists or ran.
- UNKNOWN: the required set depends on an unresolved or UNBOUNDED classification, or the profile has no entry.

**S7. Scope**
- ScopeDeclaration per (revision_hash, scope_path, category ∈ {COMPONENT, INTERFACE, RELATIONSHIP:kind, REQUIREMENT@contract_v, RULE_COVERAGE@profile_v}, abstraction_boundary).
- State is CLOSED only under an admissible named authority that is not the candidate generator. With no declaration, the scope is OPEN.
- Categories and scopes are independent of each other.
- A revision hash binds identity only.
- PARTIAL is a derived summary over subscopes.
- Release scopes are the ones the contract or profile declare, at their abstraction boundaries. A purchased actuator's internal scopes are excluded unless its admitted abstraction contract exposes them.

**S8. Findings**
- Identity = hash(kind, sorted source Dependency, scope or subject IDs).
- affected_refs = a list of (eval_id, dimension ∈ {applicability, truth, coverage}), because one classification can change applicability and coverage while truth stays constant.
- Evaluation records are always kept; Findings index them and never replace them.
- essential_exact=true only for full enumeration over finite product domains. There, a value that is not constant has an essential single variable along some single-coordinate path, so the essential set determines the function.
- Over JOINT domains, interval-abstracted scopes, UNBOUNDED domains or budget cutoffs, the Finding cites the whole dependency group with essential_exact=false. Example: over the joint domain {(0,0),(1,1)} with f=(T,F), no single variable is essential even though f is not constant.

4. DETERMINISTIC RELEASE MAPPING
- M = AND of:
  - mandatory contract requirements;
  - catalog integrity rules for installed subjects in release scopes;
  - obl(s,k).
- A = AND of advisory roots.
- R1: V(M)=F → FAIL. This holds even when the revision is INTERMEDIATE or scopes are OPEN. Adding members or conjuncts cannot turn F into T, and F required validated F atoms.
- R2: otherwise UNKNOWN if any of:
  - V(M)=U;
  - any release scope is OPEN;
  - the revision is INTERMEDIATE;
  - the mandatory contract is empty, or every mandatory contract requirement is NOT_APPLICABLE.
- R3: otherwise WARN if V(A)≠T:
  - F → ADVISORY_VIOLATION;
  - U → ADVISORY_UNRESOLVED.
  - This is my proposed completion of Codex's rule, so an unvalidated advisory condition never shows as a clean PASS.
- R4: otherwise PASS.

5. THE 12 CASES (all other prerequisites satisfied)
1. T + COVERED + CLOSED → PASS.
2. T with an uncovered obl(s,k) → M=U → UNKNOWN (COVERAGE_GAP).
3. Local T with a release scope OPEN → UNKNOWN (SCOPE_OPEN).
4. U → UNKNOWN, unless V(M)=F.
5. F → FAIL.
6. NOT_APPLICABLE meeting S5 → excluded and counted. The rest decides the verdict. If every mandatory requirement is excluded → UNKNOWN.
7. Inadmissible NOT_APPLICABLE → antecedent UNDETERMINED:
   - consequent validated T in all completions → requirement T (PASS-eligible), with conditional CAD PENDING;
   - consequent F in all completions → U → UNKNOWN.
8. Validated successful branch in every completion → T → PASS if the rest of M is T.
9. All branches F → FAIL.
10. T∨U = T; F∨U = U; correlated branches → supervaluation; crossed validation → U → UNKNOWN.
11. Empty CLOSED domain → ∀ T (NOT_APPLICABLE if it is a selector family); ∃ F → FAIL if mandatory; counts by interval.
12. Empty OPEN domain → U → UNKNOWN, except tautologies.

6. ADVERSARIAL EXAMPLES
- **Unknown type:** one UNBOUNDED classification(s), so obl(s,·) and type-dependent atoms are U. Coverage UNKNOWN. Findings: UNMAPPED_TYPE plus one UNRESOLVED_DEPENDENCY → UNKNOWN, unless an independent group is F. This also closes my seq-1 self-definition worry: a candidate-declared strategy cannot hide an installed unmapped part, because its obl stays U.
- **Missing relationship:** admitted rotating shaft, support requirement count≥k.
  - CLOSED with hi<k → FAIL.
  - OPEN with lo<k → U.
  - OPEN with lo≥k → T locally, but the release gate → UNKNOWN.
  - Motion undetermined → one Finding keyed on motion(shaft).
- **Whole subsystem deletion:** ∃ realization(controlled_rotary_output).
  - Revision-level scope CLOSED → lo=hi=0 → FAIL.
  - OPEN, or the declaration was deleted along with the subsystem → UNKNOWN.
- **Uncovered interface:** obl(i,k)=U → UNKNOWN, even though every executed check is T.
- **Classification A|B** (admissible finite domain):
  - both completions F → FAIL;
  - both T → PASS-eligible, with CAD PENDING for features whose applicability depends on x;
  - mixed → UNKNOWN.
  - One Finding, with affected refs across all three dimensions.
- **Valid alternative B:** B validated in every completion. Integrity conjuncts for installed A parts stay in M → PASS if they are T.
- **Partial design:** INTERMEDIATE → UNKNOWN unless V(M)=F. All CAD PENDING.

7. CAD GATE
CADObligation is EXECUTABLE for feature f only if all of these hold:
1. Every generating binding has applicability=APPLIES.
2. Every prerequisite Evaluation is validated T. Advisory results and waivers never count.
3. Participants are admissibly bound, have mapped types, and are the same in every completion.
4. Every parameter is an admitted Fact, the same in every completion. No defaults or fallbacks, which contradicts mechanical_component_library.py:336-349.
5. f's rule and every participant's INSTALLED_INTEGRITY categories are COVERED.
6. Every ScopeDeclaration in f's dependency cone is CLOSED.
7. The cone contains no INADMISSIBLE_EVIDENCE, EVIDENCE_CONFLICT or EVALUATION_BOUND finding.
8. The revision is DESIGN_OF_RECORD.

Otherwise f is PENDING, with blocking_refs naming the exact IDs. TRUE for an OR or implication never selects geometry by itself. EXECUTABLE means eligible for CAD generation only.

8. MINIMAL v0.1 STRUCTURES (converged with Codex seq-2; not implemented)
- Provenance{id, source_class, authority_role, source_locator, source_version, derivation_rule@v, input_fact_refs, revision_hash}
- Fact{id, subject_ref, kind: DESIGN_CHOICE|CLASSIFICATION|OPERATING_MODE|RELATIONSHIP|PARAMETER|SCOPE_CLOSURE, value, provenance_ref, admissible}
- Revision{revision_hash, status: DESIGN_OF_RECORD|INTERMEDIATE}
- Requirement{id@v, origin: CONTRACT|CATALOG_RULE, expr, severity: MANDATORY|ADVISORY, provenance_ref}
- Rule{id@v, selector, antecedent, consequent, atom_kinds, coverage_categories, cad_templates}
- CoverageProfile{id@v, subject_type→[(category, obligation_scope: INSTALLED_INTEGRITY|SELECTED_REALIZATION)]}
- ScopeDeclaration{id, revision_hash, scope_path, category, abstraction_boundary, state: CLOSED|OPEN, authority_role, provenance_ref}
- Dependency{id, kind, subject_refs, domain: FINITE(values)|JOINT(tuples)|UNBOUNDED, narrowing_fact_refs, group_id}
- RuleBinding{id, rule@v, participant_refs, provenance_refs, admissible}
- Evaluation{id, expr_ref, revision_hash, contract@v, catalog@v, profile@v, applicability, consequent_truth, requirement_truth, coverage, dependency_refs, group_id, completions_evaluated, limit: EXACT|INTERVAL|UNBOUNDED_ABSTRACTED|BUDGET_EXCEEDED|EVIDENCE_CONFLICT, witness_refs, counterexample_refs_per_completion, exclusion_refs, input_fact_refs}
- Finding{id=hash(kind, sorted source refs), kind ∈ {VIOLATION, UNRESOLVED_DEPENDENCY, COVERAGE_GAP, UNMAPPED_TYPE, SCOPE_OPEN, INADMISSIBLE_EVIDENCE, EVIDENCE_CONFLICT, EVALUATION_BOUND, ADVISORY_VIOLATION, ADVISORY_UNRESOLVED, INTERMEDIATE_REVISION, EMPTY_OR_EXCLUDED_CONTRACT}, source_refs, affected_refs[(eval_id, dimension)], essential_exact}

mechanism:
ACCEPTED CORE
Covered-success and covered-failure can be represented by strong-Kleene values within each completion. Their recursive AND/OR/NOT/implication rules require no separate service. Supervaluation must occur after combining mandatory conjuncts sharing dependencies. Factorization over nonempty, genuinely independent product domains is valid. CLOSED/OPEN suffices per bounded scope; PARTIAL summarizes subscopes. Revision identity never supplies closure.

Accept R3: when mandatory obligations and release gates pass, an unresolved advisory produces WARN with ADVISORY_UNRESOLVED; a violated advisory produces WARN with ADVISORY_VIOLATION. A satisfied advisory produces no warning. No waivers in v0.1.

SMALL SPECIFICATION CLARIFICATIONS
1. Name the evaluator output validated_truth. Preserve engineering/consequent truth separately wherever admissible evidence establishes it, plus coverage and reasons. TRUE engineering truth with missing required validation remains representable and cannot release. One expression engine can compute these projections; two services are unnecessary. Replacing an uncovered check with U is an evaluation technique, not evidence that truth and coverage are identical.
2. Execution means a matching rule/version, revision, participant binding, operating context, and admissible completion—not merely that the rule ran somewhere. Coverage requirements dependent on finite classification must be instantiated within each completion. Missing profile entries must insert an explicit U obligation even when the required-category list cannot be enumerated. Otherwise iterating an empty category list recreates vacuous PASS.
3. S5's phrase 'any check atom in the antecedent was executed' is stronger than necessary. A validated FALSE antecedent needs a sufficient admissible falsity proof. For antecedent FALSE AND U, the proven FALSE conjunct suffices; the other check need not execute. Independently mandatory validation categories remain obligations. NOT_APPLICABLE requires that proof in every admissible completion, nonempty consistent evidence, and sufficient scope closure wherever absence is used.
4. Exact factorization applies to the finite completion model, not every engineering interpretation abstracted by intervals. Shared facts, constraints, and joint-domain identities must be included when establishing independence. Interval abstraction can soundly return U for correlated count expressions that exact reasoning resolves. Record INTERVAL rather than claiming exact supervaluation. An evidence conflict beside an independent violation yields FAIL only when the violation's evidence cone is independent of the conflict.
5. CAD coverage must explicitly include required participant-interface and selected-realization validations in the feature's dependency cone. Checking only participant INSTALLED_INTEGRITY categories is insufficient. Require validated TRUE prerequisites, APPLIES generating bindings, invariant feature/participant/parameter choices, admitted evidence, mapped types, closed required scopes, and DESIGN_OF_RECORD. Advisory disposition cannot substitute for prerequisite truth. Otherwise retain PENDING with blocking references.

DETERMINISTIC RELEASE RULE
Compute the joint validated mandatory expression, including retained contract requirements and independently required profile/integrity obligations. A supported FALSE yields FAIL. Otherwise return UNKNOWN for U, incomplete required release scopes, INTERMEDIATE revision, or an empty/all-excluded mandatory contract. Otherwise return WARN for FALSE or UNKNOWN advisory obligations; otherwise PASS. Exclusion remains an internal applicability result, not a fifth release verdict. Preserve existential anchors independently of empty universal exclusions.

The proposed baseline arms now distinguish actual semantic differences: per-cell aggregation misses correlated FAIL; scalar category coverage accepts crossed evidence; literal one-extension counting gives false FAIL. Retain all twelve mission cases and seven adversarial families, with explicit local truth, coverage, release, and CAD expectations. Freeze advisory T/F/U as PASS/WARN/WARN when all mandatory gates pass.

For count>=5, extensions 0–4 all fail while the unbounded interval correctly returns U.
